File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn rolling_checksums(values: &[i32], window: usize) -> Option<Vec<i32>>
Behavior: For every complete window, emit the position-weighted checksum sum((offset+1)*value). Reject a zero window (and negative where representable). A window longer than input returns a non-null empty result; do not mutate input.
Visible example: values [2,4,1,3] with window 3 return [13,15].

Buggy source to repair:

pub fn rolling_checksums(values:&[i32],window:usize)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if window==0{return None}if window>values.len(){return Some(vec![])}Some(values.windows(window).map(|w|w.iter().sum()).collect())}
